question.content: try this puzzle. buddy the golden retriever buried some bones in the yard. he buried 3 bones under the big oak tree, 5 bones near your mom's flower garden, and 2 bones next to the shed. but uh oh, emma dug up 4 of them! how many bones are still buried in the yard? [[☃ radio 1]]

choices.clue: did you remember to add up all the bones first?
double check your adding and subtracting. slow and steady wins the race (like a T-Rex... kinda!)
think about how many bones buddy started with!
are you sure you subtracted the bones emma dug up?

hints.content: first, add up all the bones buddy buried. (you're great at addition, remember?)
then, take away the bones emma dug up. (take your time, no rush)
remember to focus on what the question is asking. it's about the bones *still* buried.
